author: aadi
note: Approved by Aadi as known-good (2026-09-28). A taste of an existing paid benefit (up to 5 AI characters), one more for a subscriber at the cap.

candidate.title: Existing opportunity: A 6th AI character for subscribers who have used all 5
candidate.what_is_different_here: The Luzia+ paywall line 'Create up to 5 AI characters' (s02.e06) gives payers a hard number. A subscriber with 5 characters who taps the Custom Bestie banner on home (s01.e22, 'Make an AI expert tailored to you') has nowhere to put a new one. A rewarded play opens one extra slot for 7 days. As with WEBTOON's 3-day unlock, the ad path is temporary, and the slot costs no extra model replies beyond the chatting the plan already covers.
candidate.trigger_event: A Luzia+ subscriber who already has 5 AI characters taps the Custom Bestie banner on home (the app knows the character count)
candidate.placement: Bottom sheet over home, opened from the Custom Bestie banner, in place of the 'you've reached your limit' state
candidate.offer_copy: You've made all 5 of your AI characters. Play a short sponsored game to open a 6th character slot for 7 days.
candidate.frequency_cap: 1 per day, resets at midnight local time; at most 1 extra slot open at a time
candidate.decline_path: The sheet closes and home is exactly as before. The subscriber keeps their 5 characters and can edit or replace one as today.
candidate.ad_fail_path: If no game is available, the sheet shows only the usual limit message with no play button. If the play can't be confirmed, a kind note says the slot wasn't added, and the daily attempt isn't used up.
candidate.subscriber_treatment: This offer is only for Luzia+ subscribers who have used all 5 character slots. It is opt-in and never shown mid-chat.
candidate.advertiser_category: Casual mobile games and productivity apps
candidate.character_use: The sheet shows the subscriber's 5 existing character avatars with an empty 6th circle that fills when the reward lands.

flow_steps.caption: A subscriber with 5 AI characters taps the Custom Bestie banner on home.
A sheet says all 5 slots are used and offers a 6th slot for 7 days for one short game.
The subscriber plays a short sponsored game and can close it at any time.
Once the play is confirmed, a 6th empty slot appears with a 7-day timer and they start building their new character.

candidate.after_reward: When the 7 days end, the 6th character is saved but paused with a note that one more short game reopens it for another week, so the subscriber comes back to play again instead of deleting a character.
candidate.rationale: Luzia+ caps characters at 5, and the most engaged subscribers are the ones who hit that cap, with no bigger plan to move to. A temporary 6th slot gives them more of what they already value without weakening the plan, because the slot is short-lived and one at a time. The slot adds no extra AI cost beyond the chatting subscribers already do, so the sponsored game pays for it easily.

economics.assumption_line: Serving cost not counted: no price observed. A rewarded view earns $9.20-16.49 eCPM in North America on Android, $1.90 in LATAM. Assumes 1 unlocked item(s); one view per reward; a publisher-net eCPM (share 1).
